name: helm-test-hook-manifest
description: A Helm chart test hook under templates/tests/ runs in the persistent cluster: registered roots outrank test-path vocabulary (review F2, probe 1d-2).

files.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: {{ include "platform.fullname" . }}-test
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": test
spec:
  containers:
    - name: smoke
      image: {{ .Values.image.repository }}
